text:
After a 2025-26 that lasted only 31 games, Matthew Tkachuk has 30 points in 22, and 25 of them are assists. He's on an eight-game point streak (1 goal, 9 assists), 18 of his points have come on the power play, and Florida controls almost 58% of the shot attempts at five-on-five with him on the ice.

The shape of his game has shifted. Last season he generated 1.49 expected goals per 60 on his own shots (expected goals measure chance quality); this season it's 0.84. He's creating for others rather than parking at the net, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking pointed that way already: 10.5 primary shot assists per 60, 95th percentile among forwards, and 69% of his zone entries carried in, though from only six tracked games.

There's a family story too. Brady arrived from Ottawa this season, and in St. Louis, where the Blues honored their father Keith, the brothers led a 4-1 win. Matthew called the tribute "Icing On The Cake," per NDTV Sports. His ice time is down about 1.3 minutes over the last ten games; worth watching whether that holds.
headline: Matthew Tkachuk is back and passing everyone dizzy
